svg.title: PromisePatch: one failed delivery, recovered under deterministic authority
svg.desc: A raspberry delivery fails. Six customer orders are checked and split into four authority lanes: AUTO (a pre-approved swap is applied), ASK (the customer is asked and answers YES on a signed link), BLOCKED (two orders go to the owner and their scheduled work is held) and UNAFFECTED (two orders are left alone). Time passes, so before the approved change is committed it is revalidated against a fresh snapshot with ten checks. It passes and the order is amended. The two unaffected orders receive zero effects.

g.text: A promise meets the physical world: the raspberries never came.
PromisePatch finds every customer promise the failure reaches.
Each promise lands in exactly one authority lane.
A worker confirms the plan. Only authorized effects run.
Where the customer must agree, they answer on a signed link.
Time passes. Stock, the kitchen and the orders may have moved.
Before a yes is acted on, it is revalidated against fresh state.
Recovered, and unrelated promises were never touched.
2 recovered · 2 escalated to the owner · 2 untouched with 0 effects
